## Summary of Changes
Provide a brief description of the problem solved or feature added by this PR.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New rule or analyzer
- [ ] Enhancement to existing rule/feature
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / performance improvement

## Verification & Testing
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes with zero errors
- [ ] `npm test` passes (all unit and integration tests)
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds across all workspaces
- [ ] `npm run package -- --no-bump` packages cleanly
- [ ] New tests added for any new rule or bug fix

## Checklist
- [ ] Code follows project conventions and architecture boundaries
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or personal machine paths are committed
- [ ] Documentation and/or changelog updated if applicable
